turns.doctor_question: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. Could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess I'm here because... honestly, I feel like I’m coming apart at the seams. 

It all started when these foreclosure notices began showing up in the mail. Ever since they started coming, I just haven't been right. I find myself sitting out in my truck crying before my shift even starts, and I jump every single time my phone rings. 

It's really messing with my work, too. I'm snapping at the apprentices, and I'm making these stupid mistakes in the repair bay that I never, ever would have made before all this. I just need some help getting a grip on things.
